about: Cells for tools/nightly.mjs, the nightly physics benchmark. Each cell names a set and a scenario from data/budget-rows.json, a ragdoll count n and whether the simultaneous-ragdoll cap (admit()) applies; its key is <set>/<scenario>/n<N>/<cap|nocap>. The nightly keeps the MEDIAN p95 of `runs` runs per cell and gates it with tools/nightly-gate.mjs.
limit_source: docs/BRIEF.md: the 3 ms physics budget; a cell above it is OVER BUDGET
regress_source: Strategy task 2026-10-28: REGRESSED when more than 20% above the previous night's stored value; no stored value means no regression flag
skip_rule: A cell whose tooling or data is absent at the checked-out sha (no admit(), no loadChainBody(), no body file, a `needs` tool that does not exist) is SKIPPED and never fails. Older game pins run their own src/ and data/ bodies with the current tools/ and this file.

cells.note: 30 pooled, never-killed humanoid ragdolls (parked:true), p95 ms per world.step; present once tools/parked-cost.mjs (PR #75) is on main
